items.title: Gloria Steinem: A voice for women, to the very end
items.signal: Potential relevance to diplomatic signalling, multilateral relations, crisis diplomacy or institutional representation.
items.source_summary: Gloria Steinem, the journalist and women's rights campaigner who became one of the most influential voices of the feminist movement, has died at the age of 92. In an announcement on Instagram, her family said she had passed away on Wednesday at her home in New York City, surrounded by some of the many who loved her.

items.title: El Niño is surging. Months of extreme heat could follow
items.signal: Potential relevance to diplomatic signalling, multilateral relations, crisis diplomacy or institutional representation.
items.source_summary: Fuelled by exceptionally warm Pacific waters, the El Niño climate pattern is intensifying and has yet to peak. Forecasters are almost certain it will persist through February 2027 – with unusually warm conditions expected across much of the world in the coming months.

items.title: One in five children in 21 nations faced tech-facilitated sexual abuse: UNICEF
items.signal: Potential relevance to diplomatic signalling, multilateral relations, crisis diplomacy or institutional representation.
items.source_summary: About 20 million children aged 12 to 17 – one in five across 21 countries – were sexually exploited by perpetrators using technology such as social media, according to a UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) report released on Thursday.
